yearMeaning: The 1944 massacre is the historical event, not an established founding year for the civic remembrance. Formal introduction year requires primary legislative confirmation.
authority: Czech Republic; commemorative recognition described by IHRA
dateReason: The night of 8–9 March 1944 saw the murder of prisoners from the Theresienstadt family camp at Auschwitz-Birkenau; Czech civic remembrance is listed on 9 March.

sourceEvidence.claim: IHRA country report lists March 9 as a Czech remembrance day and records the murder of 3,792 prisoners on the night of 8–9 March 1944.
Czech Ministry of Culture documents the destruction of the family camp during the night of 8–9 March 1944 and a 2023 memorial event.

narratives.en: On 9 March, Czechia remembers the victims of the Theresienstadt family camp at Auschwitz-Birkenau. During the night of 8–9 March 1944, Nazi perpetrators murdered thousands of Jewish prisoners deported from Terezín. The date preserves the memory of one of the largest mass murders of Czechoslovak citizens during the Second World War. Czech and international remembrance institutions document the commemoration; the precise year of its formal introduction is not yet established here.
narratives.it: Il 9 marzo la Repubblica Ceca ricorda le vittime del campo per famiglie di Terezín ad Auschwitz-Birkenau. Nella notte tra l'8 e il 9 marzo 1944 i nazisti uccisero migliaia di prigionieri ebrei deportati da Terezín. La data conserva la memoria di uno dei maggiori massacri di cittadini cecoslovacchi durante la Seconda guerra mondiale. Istituzioni ceche e internazionali documentano la commemorazione; l'anno preciso della sua istituzione formale non è ancora accertato.
narratives.es: El 9 de marzo, Chequia recuerda a las víctimas del campo familiar de Terezín en Auschwitz-Birkenau. Durante la noche del 8 al 9 de marzo de 1944, los nazis asesinaron a miles de prisioneros judíos deportados desde Terezín. La fecha preserva la memoria de una de las mayores matanzas de ciudadanos checoslovacos durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Instituciones checas e internacionales documentan la conmemoración; aún no se ha establecido aquí el año exacto de su instauración formal.
narratives.fr: Le 9 mars, la Tchéquie rend hommage aux victimes du camp familial de Terezín à Auschwitz-Birkenau. Dans la nuit du 8 au 9 mars 1944, les nazis assassinèrent des milliers de prisonniers juifs déportés de Terezín. Cette date entretient le souvenir de l'un des plus grands massacres de citoyens tchécoslovaques pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale. Des institutions tchèques et internationales attestent cette commémoration ; l'année exacte de son instauration officielle reste à établir.
narratives.de: Am 9. März gedenkt Tschechien der Opfer des Theresienstädter Familienlagers in Auschwitz-Birkenau. In der Nacht vom 8. auf den 9. März 1944 ermordeten die Nationalsozialisten Tausende jüdische Gefangene, die aus Terezín deportiert worden waren. Das Datum erinnert an eines der größten Massaker an tschechoslowakischen Bürgern im Zweiten Weltkrieg. Tschechische und internationale Gedenkinstitutionen belegen das Gedenken; das genaue Jahr seiner förmlichen Einführung ist hier noch nicht gesichert.
narratives.pt: A 9 de março, a Chéquia recorda as vítimas do campo familiar de Terezín em Auschwitz-Birkenau. Na noite de 8 para 9 de março de 1944, os nazis assassinaram milhares de prisioneiros judeus deportados de Terezín. A data preserva a memória de um dos maiores massacres de cidadãos checoslovacos durante a Segunda Guerra Mundial. Instituições checas e internacionais documentam esta evocação; o ano exato da sua instituição formal continua por confirmar.
